test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

“I have been to Hyderabad”, Vishnu told me.

options.text: Vishnu told me that he has being to Hyderabad.
Vishnu told me that he had been to Hyderabad.
Vishnu told me that he have be to Hyderabad.
Vishnu tell me that he has been to Hyderabad.

solution:
The correct answer is Option (2). [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the steps for changing the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• In the given sentence the reporting verb is '**told' **its object is '**me**'. It will not be changed.
 
• Comma (,) and inverted commas("...") will be removed. 
 
• The conjunction 'that' will be added.
 
• 'I' will be changed into 'he' according to the subject (Vishnu) of the reporting speech.
 
• Here, "have been" turns into "had been" according to the rules of tense changes. (More in the addition information)

Therefore, the correct answer is *"****Vishnu told me that he had been to Hyderabad.****"*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The following table will enable us to know how tense changes in indirect speech:-

 Indirect Speech

 (Subject + is/am/are + V1 + ing + Object)
